io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks

Class MultiBlock

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.multiblocks.MultiBlock

  • public class MultiBlock
extends java.lang.Object
    A MultiBlock represents a structure build in a World. A MultiBlock is often linked to a MultiBlockMachine and is used to recognize that machine in a MultiBlockInteractEvent.
    See Also:
    MultiBlockMachine, MultiBlockInteractionHandler, MultiBlockInteractEvent

      • matches

        public boolean matches(@Nonnull
                       org.bukkit.block.Block center)
        Checks whether this MultiBlock's structure is present, treating the given Block as the structure's center (the blocks[4] cell). Shared by the interaction listener and the redstone auto-craft listener.
        Parameters:
        center - The block to test as the structure's center
        Returns:
        Whether a valid orientation of this structure exists around center

      • containsBlock

        public boolean containsBlock(@Nonnull
                             org.bukkit.block.Block center,
                             @Nonnull
                             org.bukkit.block.Block placed)
        Whether placed occupies one of this structure's non-null cells when centred at center, in the orientation that matches. Used to confirm a just-placed block is genuinely part of a newly completed structure, rather than an unrelated block set down beside an already-complete one (which would otherwise re-announce "Assembled").
